import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TensorStalkLocalization
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteSupportVanishing
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyLocalLength
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LocalizedFiniteLength
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivCurvePushforwardProducers
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.Divisor

/-!
# The Weil divisor of a finite-support quotient

The multiplicity of an effective divisor at a closed point is the length of
its structure sheaf at that point.  The construction below uses the actual
stalks of the quotient sheaf, without choosing a global equation or a global
trivialization of its ideal.  This is an AJC-native curve specialization
supporting the invertible-ideal construction in Kleiman, *The Picard scheme*,
Section 3, `sb:ediv`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Finite length of sections on a restricted scheme transfers to the same
open in the ambient scheme, with its own coordinate-ring action. -/
theorem isFiniteLength_sections_of_restrict
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (F : X.Modules) (V : Y.Opens)
    (h : IsFiniteLength Γ(Y, V) Γ(F.restrict j, V)) :
    IsFiniteLength Γ(X, j ''ᵁ V) Γ(F, j ''ᵁ V) := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, j ''ᵁ V) := (j.appIso V).inv.hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Module Γ(Y, V) Γ(F, j ''ᵁ V) :=
    Module.compHom _ (j.appIso V).inv.hom
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, j ''ᵁ V) Γ(F, j ''ᵁ V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul (fun _ _ => rfl)
  have hl : IsFiniteLength Γ(Y, V) Γ(F, j ''ᵁ V) := h
  obtain ⟨hn, ha⟩ := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hl
  exact isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr
    ⟨isNoetherian_of_tower Γ(Y, V) hn, isArtinian_of_tower Γ(Y, V) ha⟩

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The stalk of a quasi-coherent module is the localization of its sections
on any affine neighbourhood. -/
theorem isLocalizedModule_moduleGermLinearMap
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (x : U) :
    letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
      presheafStalkModule F.val x
    letI : Module Γ(X, U)
        (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
      Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.germ U x x.2).hom
    IsLocalizedModule (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.primeCompl
      (presheafGermLinearMap F.val x) := by
  apply isLocalizedModule_presheafGermLinearMap F.val hU x
  intro f
  letI : Module Γ(X, U) Γ(F, X.basicOpen f) :=
    Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) Γ(F, X.basicOpen f) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul (fun _ _ => rfl)
  exact isLocalizedModule_basicOpen F hU f

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A finitely presented module is nonzero at a stalk exactly on its
schematic support. -/
theorem mem_annihilator_support_iff_nontrivial_stalk
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (x : X) :
    x ∈ (annihilator F).support ↔
      Nontrivial (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := x) (U := ⊤) trivial
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    presheafStalkModule F.val x
  letI : Module Γ(X, U)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation F ⟨U, hU⟩
  haveI := isLocalizedModule_moduleGermLinearMap F hU ⟨x, hxU⟩
  have hmem (I : Ideal Γ(X, U)) :
      x ∈ X.zeroLocus (U := U) I ↔
        hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩ ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I := by
    rw [← hU.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus]
    change x ∈ X.zeroLocus (U := U) I ↔
      hU.fromSpec (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩) ∈ X.zeroLocus (U := U) I
    rw [hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf]
  rw [IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem (I := annihilator F)
      (U := ⟨U, hU⟩) hxU,
    annihilator_ideal F
      (fun V => module_finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation F V) ⟨U, hU⟩,
    hmem,
    ← Module.support_eq_zeroLocus]
  let e := IsLocalizedModule.iso (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
    (presheafGermLinearMap F.val ⟨x, hxU⟩)
  rw [Module.mem_support_iff]
  exact e.toEquiv.nontrivial_congr

/-- A module with schematic support finite over a field has finitely many
nonzero stalks. -/
theorem finite_nontrivial_stalk_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ p)) :
    {x : X | Nontrivial (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u)}.Finite := by
  letI := hfin
  have hsupport : (Set.univ : Set (schematicSupport F)).Finite := by
    simpa only [Set.preimage_univ] using
      (schematicSupportι F ≫ p).finite_preimage
        (Set.toFinite (Set.univ : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))))
  have hrange : (Set.range (schematicSupportι F)).Finite :=
    by simpa only [Set.image_univ] using hsupport.image (schematicSupportι F)
  have heq : Set.range (schematicSupportι F) =
      {x : X | Nontrivial (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u)} := by
    have hr : Set.range (schematicSupportι F) = (annihilator F).support :=
      (annihilator F).range_subschemeι
    rw [hr]
    ext x
    exact mem_annihilator_support_iff_nontrivial_stalk F x
  exact heq ▸ hrange

/-- The intrinsic local length of a sheaf of modules.  It remains an extended
natural number until finite length has been proved. -/
noncomputable def stalkLength (F : X.Modules) (x : X) : ℕ∞ :=
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    presheafStalkModule F.val x
  Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u)

/-- Local length detects exactly the nonzero stalks, including before finite
length has been established. -/
theorem stalkLength_ne_zero_iff (F : X.Modules) (x : X) :
    stalkLength F x ≠ 0 ↔
      Nontrivial (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) := by
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    presheafStalkModule F.val x
  exact (pos_iff_ne_zero.symm).trans Module.length_pos_iff

/-- Isomorphic quotient sheaves have the same intrinsic multiplicities. -/
theorem stalkLength_eq_of_iso {F G : X.Modules} (e : F ≅ G) (x : X) :
    stalkLength F x = stalkLength G x := by
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    presheafStalkModule F.val x
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk G.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    presheafStalkModule G.val x
  exact (PresheafOfModules.stalkLinearEquivOfIsIso e.hom.val x
    (inferInstanceAs (IsIso
      ((toPresheaf X ⋙ TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map e.hom)))).length_eq

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The quotient by an invertible ideal on a smooth curve has finite length
at every stalk.  Only local trivializations of the kernel are used. -/
theorem stalkLength_ne_top_of_cartier
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 p] [IsIntegral X]
    {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (eO : E ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (hI : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial (kernel q)) (x : X) :
    stalkLength F x ≠ ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU, ⟨eI⟩⟩ := hI x
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
  let P := restrictFunctor U.ι
  let qU := P.map q
  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} P :=
    (restrictAdjunction U.ι).leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  haveI : Epi qU := Functor.map_epi P q
  haveI : ((pullback U.ι).obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation U.ι F inferInstance
  haveI : (P.obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app F).symm inferInstance
  let eOU : P.obj E ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf :=
    P.mapIso eO ≪≫ (restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app _ ≪≫ pullbackUnitIso U.ι
  let eIU : kernel qU ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf :=
    (PreservesKernel.iso P q).symm ≪≫ eI
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (U.ι ≫ p) := IsZariskiLocalAtSource.comp ‹_› U.ι
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hD⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isDedekindDomain_section (U.ι ≫ p) ⟨x, hxU⟩
  letI := hD
  have hlen : IsFiniteLength Γ((U : Scheme), V) Γ(P.obj F, V) :=
    CartierKernel.isFiniteLength_sections_quotient qU eOU eIU V hV
  let W := U.ι ''ᵁ V
  have hW : IsAffineOpen W := hV.image_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, hxV, rfl⟩
  have hlenW : IsFiniteLength Γ(X, W) Γ(F, W) :=
    isFiniteLength_sections_of_restrict U.ι F V hlen
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    presheafStalkModule F.val x
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxW⟩
  letI : Module Γ(X, W)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.germ W x hxW).hom
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul (fun _ _ => rfl)
  letI := hW.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxW⟩
  haveI := isLocalizedModule_moduleGermLinearMap F hW ⟨x, hxW⟩
  exact Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr
    (IsFiniteLength.of_isLocalizedModule (S := X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxW⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
      (presheafGermLinearMap F.val ⟨x, hxW⟩) hlenW)

/-- The local-length multiplicities of a sheaf with finite schematic support
have finite support on the curve's closed-point carrier. -/
theorem finite_support_stalkLength_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    [IsIntegral X] {K : Type u} [Field K]
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ p)) :
    (Function.support (fun x : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X} => stalkLength F x)).Finite := by
  have hs := finite_nontrivial_stalk_of_isFinite_schematicSupport p F hfin
  have ht : {x : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X} |
      Nontrivial (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u)}.Finite :=
    hs.preimage (f := fun x : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X} => x.1)
      Subtype.val_injective.injOn
  convert ht using 1
  ext x
  exact stalkLength_ne_zero_iff F x

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π]
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S}

local instance fieldTest_isIntegral : IsIntegral (pullback π s) :=
  GeometricallyIntegral.geometrically_isIntegral (f := π) s
    (pullback.fst π s) (pullback.snd π s) (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π s)

local instance fieldTest_smooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (pullback.snd π s) := by
  letI := smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange 1
  exact MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ ‹SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π›

/-- The multiplicity of a divisor family at a field-valued test point.  The
finite-length proof, obtained from the locally invertible kernel, is required
to extract a natural number from the extended local length. -/
noncomputable def stalkMultiplicity (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (z : (pullback π s : Scheme)) : ℕ := by
  letI : Epi x.q := x.epi
  letI : x.F.IsFinitePresentation := x.isFinitePresentation
  exact (Modules.stalkLength x.F z).lift (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr
    (Modules.stalkLength_ne_top_of_cartier (pullback.snd π s) x.q
      (Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π s)) x.kerLocallyTrivial z))

/-- The extracted multiplicity recovers the actual stalk length. -/
@[simp] theorem coe_stalkMultiplicity (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (z : (pullback π s : Scheme)) :
    (x.stalkMultiplicity z : ℕ∞) = Modules.stalkLength x.F z := by
  simp only [stalkMultiplicity, ENat.coe_lift]

variable [IsProper π]

/-- The effective Weil divisor associated to a divisor family on a field
test.  Finite support is supplied by the smooth proper curve theorem. -/
noncomputable def effectiveWeilDivisor (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    (pullback π s).CurveDivisor :=
  Finsupp.ofSupportFinite
    (fun z : {z : (pullback π s : Scheme) // z ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)} =>
      (x.stalkMultiplicity z : ℤ)) (by
    letI : x.F.IsFinitePresentation := x.isFinitePresentation
    apply (Modules.finite_support_stalkLength_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
      (pullback.snd π s) x.F (isFinite_support_of_curve x)).subset
    intro z hz
    simp only [Function.mem_support] at hz ⊢
    contrapose! hz
    change (x.stalkMultiplicity z : ℤ) = 0
    have h : x.stalkMultiplicity z = 0 := by
      apply ENat.coe_inj.mp
      rw [coe_stalkMultiplicity]
      exact hz
    exact_mod_cast h)

@[simp] theorem effectiveWeilDivisor_apply (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (z : {z : (pullback π s : Scheme) // z ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)}) :
    x.effectiveWeilDivisor.toFun z = (x.stalkMultiplicity z : ℤ) := rfl

/-- The coefficient is the intrinsic local length, with its finiteness proved
before passing to an ordinary integer coefficient. -/
theorem effectiveWeilDivisor_coefficient_length (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (z : {z : (pullback π s : Scheme) // z ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)}) :
    ((x.effectiveWeilDivisor.toFun z).toNat : ℕ∞) = Modules.stalkLength x.F z.1 := by
  simpa only [effectiveWeilDivisor_apply, Int.toNat_natCast] using
    x.coe_stalkMultiplicity z

/-- Every coefficient of the associated Weil divisor is nonnegative. -/
theorem effectiveWeilDivisor_nonneg (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    0 ≤ x.effectiveWeilDivisor := by
  intro z
  exact Int.natCast_nonneg _

/-- The associated Weil divisor has exactly the non-generic points of the
schematic support of the divisor family. -/
theorem mem_support_effectiveWeilDivisor_iff (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (z : {z : (pullback π s : Scheme) // z ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)}) :
    z ∈ x.effectiveWeilDivisor.support ↔ z.1 ∈ (Modules.annihilator x.F).support := by
  letI : x.F.IsFinitePresentation := x.isFinitePresentation
  rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
  change (x.stalkMultiplicity z : ℤ) ≠ 0 ↔ _
  rw [Int.natCast_ne_zero,
    Modules.mem_annihilator_support_iff_nontrivial_stalk,
    ← Modules.stalkLength_ne_zero_iff, ← coe_stalkMultiplicity]
  exact not_congr ENat.coe_inj.symm

/-- Equivalent quotient presentations produce the same Weil divisor. -/
theorem effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_of_rel
    {x y : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)} (h : x.Rel y) :
    x.effectiveWeilDivisor = y.effectiveWeilDivisor := by
  obtain ⟨e, -⟩ := h
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro z
  change (x.stalkMultiplicity z : ℤ) = (y.stalkMultiplicity z : ℤ)
  congr 1
  apply ENat.coe_inj.mp
  rw [coe_stalkMultiplicity, coe_stalkMultiplicity,
    Modules.stalkLength_eq_of_iso e]

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
